overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried beetroot powder from fresh beetroots using advanced spray drying technology. We process pure extracted juice using low-temperature drying to preserve natural color and flavor. The resulting fine powder provides rapid solubility and uniform particle consistency. It serves as a reliable natural colorant and functional ingredient for diverse global food and beverage formulations.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter based in India, we deliver bulk supply and OEM solutions. Our production follows a structured six-step process, from careful sourcing and sorting to controlled processing and dispatch. With moisture maintained below five percent, our spray dried powder offers strong color stability, extended shelf life, and seamless integration into industrial production lines.
highlights: Fine powder with 80-100 standard mesh size
Rapid moisture removal yielding under 5% moisture content
Vibrant natural red betalain pigment retention
Free from artificial colors, preservatives, and added fillers
Instant solubility in liquid and solid food matrices
Consistent particle size for industrial mixing and formulation
applications: Bakery products including breads and muffins
Smoothies and dry instant drink formulations
Instant soup mixes and ready-to-eat foods

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. We support trial batches as well as commercial container loads.

faqs.q: What are the primary specifications of the spray dried beetroot powder?
faqs.a: The product features an 80 to 100 mesh size, moisture content below 5%, and an 18 to 24 month shelf life.

faqs.q: Do you provide private label and OEM services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide full OEM and private label services, including custom packaging, pouch formats, and jar packing.

faqs.q: Can you customize mesh sizes based on formulation requirements?
faqs.a: Yes, we accommodate requests for specific mesh sizes to suit different industrial machinery and dissolution needs.

faqs.q: Are samples available for evaluation before ordering?
faqs.a: We provide product samples on request to assist your technical formulation and quality evaluation before bulk purchase.

faqs.q: What export documentation support is provided with shipments?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we furnish standard export documentation and batch traceability to support seamless customs clearance.
